items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT for Sunday. Confirmed across injury reports.
items.implication: Houston WR targets redistribute; TE and remaining WRs rise.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining pass-catchers especially TE.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; Jaylen Warren QUESTIONABLE but projected lead back.
items.why: Toe injury; coach says Warren will lead the group and stay fresh.
items.implication: Warren elevated to clear lead RB role with checkdown upside.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + pass-game work; backups Homer/Heidenreich limited.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Sam Darnold (SEA) good to go.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; longer-term positive news per reports.
items.opportunity: WAS pass-catchers see QB change; McLaurin still viable but matchup-dependent.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Seeking clarity on Flowers, Mitchell, DJ Moore.
items.why: Internal projections based on practice/reports; DFS implications large.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no late scratch; monitor for changes.
items.opportunity: Full roles if active; Bowers TE1, Evans WR volume, Warren lead.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT (expected IR). Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role.
items.why: Injury leading to IR; limited career games.
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back with Dillon as primary backup.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (top 25th percentile sim average) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim-based ceiling; projections live and updating for news.
items.implication: Elite smash play with massive upside in any format.
items.opportunity: High volume potential in favorable spot.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Committee continues with both healthy; reverse any Coleman stash value short-term.
items.opportunity: Shared carries; monitor split but both viable in deeper formats.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect heavy checkdowns as vertical game has failed for Rodgers. Projecting Warren in despite Q (shoulder).
items.why: Coach comments + Rodgers checkdown need; practice squad backups only.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with reception upside in favorable usage.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share; goal-line and third-down work.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit targets, high aDOT, LV allows high YPR) and Dalton Schultz (@ IND: 28% target share sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs).
items.why: Usage metrics + matchup; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.implication: Olave WR2/3 smash; Schultz TE1 streaming upside.
items.opportunity: Target share and yards; Schultz routes/targets elevated.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Prior misses: strong TD and yardage production.
items.why: Historical route and target data sans Nacua.
items.implication: Elite WR1 play this week if Nacua sits.
items.opportunity: High target rate, red-zone, and volume expansion.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run defense; high prop line.
items.opportunity: Volume and yards upside in favorable game script.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yards to RBs.
items.why: Proven high utilization + soft run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB2 start with receiving work.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson (@ JAX: low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough run D), Travis Etienne (vs LV: low snap/touch share even with Kamara), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: elite WR D, low team total).
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better options; Henderson rising in NE.
items.conflict: Daniels OUT may not fully tank McLaurin per Berry facts, but still hates matchup.
